text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown prepares to take on the 
Kikuka Sho. She is motivated to give it 
her all for the sake of Duramente, who was 
unable to run due to a fracture, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black couldn't afford to lose 
either. With the resolve to become a star 
carrying everyone's expectations, she had 
overcome grueling training alongside her 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown senses an extraordinary aura 
from Kitasan Black. The turbulent Kikuka 
Sho is about to begin—!
